cases.title: Real-time Text Metrics Update and Large Text Support
cases.description: Verify that typing text in data-testid='text-input' dynamically updates word, character, and paragraph counts without restriction up to 5000 characters, and persists the state in localStorage.

cases.title: Character Limit Warning Indicator
cases.description: Verify that setting a limit via data-testid='char-limit' turns the text color red in data-testid='char-count' when the limit is exceeded.

cases.title: Word Highlighting Functionality
cases.description: Verify that entering a word in id='highlight-word' and clicking id='highlight-button' highlights specific words within the text input.

cases.title: Count Calculation and Edge Cases via Count Button
cases.description: Verify that clicking data-testid='count-button' calculates accurate word, character, and paragraph counts handling edge cases like empty inputs, spaces/newlines only, and special characters, and reloads from localStorage upon page refresh.

cases.title: Clear Input and Reset Counts
cases.description: Verify that clicking data-testid='clear-button' clears the text input and resets all counts to zero immediately, even when the input is already empty.

opinions.feedback: The provided test cases cover all distinct requirements comprehensively, testability is high, and there are no blockers or contradictions found between the requirements and the test scenarios.
The test cases and requirements are well-aligned, consistent, and fully testable based on the provided specifications.

analysis.analysis: Requirement e2edev_bench_36-R-1: Testable behaviors include unrestricted free text input via data-testid='text-input', dynamic updating of word, character, and paragraph counts in respective data-testid elements, support for text lengths up to 5000 characters, persistence of state in localStorage ('text', 'words', 'chars', 'paras'), character limit enforcement via data-testid='char-limit' with red text color indication in 'char-count', clearing functionality via data-testid='clear-button', and word highlighting via id='highlight-button' and id='highlight-word'. Boundaries include a 5000 character length limit (or lack of strict blocking up to this length) and character limit thresholds. Normal paths involve typing text, seeing counts update, setting limits, and clearing or highlighting. Abnormal paths involve exceeding character limits and handling empty/special inputs. Ambiguities include whether the text is blocked beyond 5000 characters or just tested up to that length. Requirement e2edev_bench_36-R-2: Testable behaviors include entering text in data-testid='text-input' and triggering calculation via data-testid='count-button', accurate counting rules (excluding empty word strings, including all characters for chars, counting non-empty lines separated by newlines for paragraphs), persistence and reload from localStorage, and character limit styling. Boundaries include edge cases like empty input, spaces/newlines only, and special characters. Normal paths involve entering text and clicking 'Count'. Abnormal paths involve malformed inputs or exceeding limits. Ambiguities include whether counting happens on-the-fly (from R-1) or strictly upon clicking 'Count' (from R-2), representing a contradiction/overlap in trigger mechanisms. Requirement e2edev_bench_36-R-3: Testable behaviors include resetting text input and all counts to zero via data-testid='clear-button', updating UI immediately, and reflecting zero states ('Words: 0', 'Characters: 0', 'Paragraphs: 0'). Boundaries include clicking when input is already empty. Normal paths involve clicking clear on populated input. Abnormal paths involve clearing empty states. No significant ambiguities identified.
